rules.explanation: For global equal-area mapping, pseudocylindrical forms like Mollweide or Eckert IV preserve proportional sizes across continents.
Albers Equal-Area Conic is the gold standard for mid-latitude country or continental equal-area mapping (e.g. US Census Bureau).
Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) provides conformal, low-distortion site and regional mapping with scale distortion below 0.1% within each zone.
Lambert Conformal Conic preserves local angles and directions across mid-latitude bands with wide east-west extent.
Azimuthal projections in polar aspect are standard for Arctic and Antarctic sea-ice and cryosphere data.
Compromise projections distribute minor distortion across area and shape to deliver a harmonious, familiar world outline.
Azimuthal Equidistant preserves true scale from the map center point to every other location.
